title: Blockscout API: Invalid address format
summary: Blockscout's Etherscan-compatible API rejected an address parameter as malformed.
likelyCauses: The request used an address that is not a 20-byte hex string with a 0x prefix.
The address parameter was omitted, truncated, checksummed incorrectly by the caller, or replaced with a non-address identifier.
nextSteps: Validate the address before calling the Blockscout API.
If the user entered a transaction hash, block number, ENS/name, or token symbol, route it to the matching search or lookup endpoint instead.

title: Blockscout API: Invalid txhash format
summary: Blockscout's Etherscan-compatible API rejected a transaction hash parameter as malformed.
likelyCauses: The request used a transaction hash that is not a 32-byte hex string with a 0x prefix.
An address, block number, or user-facing search query was sent to a transaction-specific endpoint.
nextSteps: Validate the transaction hash shape before using transaction endpoints.
If the input is ambiguous, call Blockscout search first and route by result type.

title: Blockscout API: Unknown module
summary: Blockscout's Etherscan-compatible API could not route the requested module.
likelyCauses: The query string uses an unsupported module name.
The integration is sending an Etherscan-compatible call to a Blockscout instance that does not implement that module.
nextSteps: Check the module/action pair against the Blockscout instance API docs.
Prefer the v2 REST endpoint for new integrations when the Etherscan-compatible module is unavailable.

title: Blockscout API: Missing or invalid action
summary: Blockscout could not route the action for an Etherscan-compatible API request.
likelyCauses: The action parameter is missing, misspelled, or not supported for the selected module.
The app is using an Etherscan endpoint variant that this Blockscout instance does not expose.
nextSteps: Validate the module/action pair before sending the request.
Use the instance's API docs or migrate the integration path to the equivalent v2 REST endpoint.

title: Blockscout API v2: Invalid path value
summary: Blockscout API v2 returned a validation error for a path or query parameter.
likelyCauses: A path parameter such as address_hash_param, transaction_hash_param, or block_hash_or_number_param does not match the expected format.
The request builder routed a user search term into a typed endpoint without validating it first.
nextSteps: Read the errors array and surface the pointer and expected pattern to the user or caller.
Validate the input locally and use search/discovery endpoints for ambiguous values.

title: Blockscout API: Rate limit exceeded
summary: A Blockscout API request exceeded the instance or API key rate limit.
likelyCauses: The integration is sending more requests than the instance allows for the current IP, temporary token, or API key.
A backfill, polling loop, or retry policy is not respecting Blockscout's per-endpoint limits.
nextSteps: Back off, cache repeated lookups, and add jittered retries.
Use an API key or Blockscout PRO/API plan when the integration needs sustained multichain throughput.
examples: {"status":"0","message":"NOTOK","result":"Max rate limit reached, please use API Key for higher rate limit"}

title: Blockscout API: Query timeout
summary: Blockscout could not complete the requested explorer query within the allowed time.
likelyCauses: The request scans too many blocks, transactions, logs, token transfers, or internal transactions.
Pagination, date range, or block range limits are missing from a backfill request.
nextSteps: Split the request into smaller block ranges or pages.
Persist cursors and avoid retrying the same large unbounded query.
examples: {"status":"0","message":"NOTOK","result":"Query Timeout occured. Please select a smaller result dataset"}

title: Blockscout API: Contract source code not verified
summary: Blockscout cannot return ABI/source data because the contract is not verified on that explorer instance.
likelyCauses: The contract bytecode exists on-chain but has not been verified in Blockscout.
The app is relying on explorer ABI lookup instead of a bundled ABI or bytecode/signature fallback.
nextSteps: Fall back to the selector catalog, bytecode database, or a known ABI bundle.
Ask the contract owner or integration team to verify the contract on the relevant Blockscout instance.

title: Blockscout API: No transactions found
summary: Blockscout found no transactions for the requested address, filter, or block range.
likelyCauses: The address has no indexed transactions matching the requested range or direction filter.
The integration queried the wrong chain, explorer instance, or chain ID.
nextSteps: Check the chain ID and explorer URL against the Blockscout chain registry.
Broaden the block range or remove direction filters before reporting the account as inactive.
